usedFor: Trello tracks cards, and SOLAPI sends a text through your SOLAPI account with “Send Message” when “Card Updated” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “Card Updated” in Trello, then “Send Message” in SOLAPI
bestTemplate.why: A card change sends a text through your SOLAPI account, so the right person hears at once.

watchOut: “Card Updated” fires on every change to a card, so “Send Message” can go out repeatedly.
